card.name: Start of tetrabenazine and similar names
card.fires_on: The first letter piece of a word that is split into parts, most often the 't' of tetrabenazine after 'from', 'receiving' or 'of'. It also fires on starts of other split terms such as iodine-123, WBC, anaphylactic and LUTATHERA.

modes.label: Tetrabenazine start
modes.description: The first letter of tetrabenazine after a word like from, receiving or withdrawing.

modes.label: Other split terms
modes.description: The first piece of other split terms such as iodine, WBC or a drug name in capitals.

modes.label: Capitalized warning words
modes.description: The first piece of a capitalized word in a warning heading.
